posts.zh:
dsh-chinese-mode 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。全局中文模式：输入框旁的「中」字开关，开启后向任意预设的系统提示注入语言要求，各区域可分别设为中文或英文；锚定模式下，锚定预设的思考强制为英文。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-a102325bcdf2db4e35d9.html
posts.en:
dsh-chinese-mode is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Global Simplified-Chinese mode: a 中 switch in the input box that injects language requirements (Chinese or English per region) into every session's system prompt; anchored mode forces English thinking for anchored presets.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-a102325bcdf2db4e35d9.html
